name: Mangrove kayaking

seo.title: Mangrove Kayaking on Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Half a day by kayak in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove on Koh Lanta, morning or afternoon, with lunch at the mangrove restaurant and hotel transfer. From 1,000 THB.

h1: Kayaking in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove
lead: Half a day paddling through the mangrove channels on the east coast of Koh Lanta, then lunch at the mangrove restaurant.
promise: Half a day by kayak in the mangrove, with lunch

facts.label: Start
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng pier, east coast

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

options.label: Mangrove kayaking with lunch, half day

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove kayaking with lunch. You paddle around the mangrove forest, then eat at the mangrove restaurant. 09:30 to 12:30 or 14:00 to 17:00.

faq.a: Yes. Lunch, drinks and seasonal fruit come with every trip. The village entrance fee is the only extra.
Yes. Children from 4 to 11 have their own rate.

photos.alt: Kayaks paddling along the mangrove roots at Thung Yee Peng
